items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Gary King' and 'Bob' in response to a statement about Sly, but does not mention Sly directly or describe a personal relationship with Sly.

ctx.x: He did some funky stuff, because he did the session with Sly, playing in time. It was like, nobody playing . . .
Bob got these guys. I know Gary King was on there. That’s for sure. He died too.
